test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
match the political parties of British India in column A with their respective founders in column B.

<div
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1: a-iv, b-i, c-ii, d-iii**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **All India Forward Bloc** was founded by **Subhash Chandra Bose** in 1939 after he resigned from the Indian National Congress.
 
• **Arya Samaj** was founded by **Dayananda Sarasvati** in 1875 to promote values and practices based on the infallibility of the Vedas.
 
• **The Congress Socialist Party** was founded by **Jai Prakash Narayan** in 1934 as a socialist caucus within the Indian National Congress.
 
• **The Indian National Liberal Federation** was founded by **Surendra Nath Banerjee** in 1918 to support constitutional reforms and a more moderate approach to achieving Indian self-rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subhash Chandra Bose**

 
 
• He was a prominent leader of the Indian independence movement.
 
• Bose formed the Indian National Army (INA) to fight against British rule.
 
 
 
• **Dayananda Sarasvati**
 
 
• He was a key figure in the Hindu reform movements.
 
• He promoted the idea of Swaraj (self-rule) and return to the Vedic values.
 
 
 
• **Jai Prakash Narayan**
 
 
• He was an Indian independence activist and political leader.
 
• He played a significant role in the Quit India Movement and later led the JP Movement against Indira Gandhi's government.
 
 
 
• **Surendra Nath Banerjee**
 
 
• He was one of the earliest Indian political leaders during the British Raj.
 
• Banerjee was instrumental in the founding of the Indian National Association, which later merged with the Indian National Congress.
